summary: dpaste is a lightweight pastebin application designed for sharing text snippets and source code via short, memorable URLs. It provides a simple web interface for quick publishing without complex overhead. The project is written in Python and released under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you need a straightforward, self-hosted text-sharing utility for a local network or small team.
watchOut: The repository has very low maintenance activity and infrequent releases, meaning you should expect to handle any bug fixes or security patches yourself.
deployNotes: Because the application runs on Python within a Docker container, you will typically need to configure a persistent volume for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
